entities.summary: Yehor Yevhenovych "Egor" Shastin is a Ukrainian-Russian professional ice hockey player who is currently playing for Torpedo Nizhny Novgorod in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by Calgary Flames in the 4th round of the 2001 NHL Entry Draft.
